# Tool Reference

`gdb-mcp` exposes 98 explicit tools for GDB workflows. Every tool
that operates on a session requires an explicit `session_id`; there is no
implicit current session.

Safety levels:

- `Read`: reads debugger or target state (`readOnlyHint=true`).
- `Mutation`: changes debugger state such as breakpoints, selected frames, or paths.
- `Execution`: starts, resumes, interrupts, attaches, detaches, or kills a target.
- `Unsafe`: requires `--unsafe` or `GDB_MCP_ALLOW_UNSAFE=1`.

Tool discovery profiles:

- `full` is the compatible default and publishes all 98 tools.
- `core` publishes the 29-tool common local-debugging surface.
- `advanced:<group>[,<group>]` publishes `core` plus selected `binary_analysis`,
  `reverse_debugging`, `remote_target`, `diagnostics`, or `unsafe` groups.
- Combine with `--tools` / `--exclude-tools` (or `GDB_MCP_TOOLS` /
  `GDB_MCP_EXCLUDE_TOOLS`); `exclude` takes precedence.

## Session Management

| Tool | Safety | Profile | Parameters | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gdb_create_session` | Mutation | `core` | `program`, `args`, `cwd`, `gdb_path`, `startup_timeout` | Create an isolated GDB session and optionally load a program. |
| `gdb_apply_init_profile` | Mutation | `full` | `session_id`*, `profile`*, `source_directories`, `sysroot`, `solib_search_path`, `substitute_paths`, `debug_file_directories`, `debuginfod_enabled`, `debuginfod_urls`, `init_file`, `timeout` | Apply and record a named initialization profile for an existing session. |
| `gdb_attach` | Execution | `core` | `pid`*, `session_id`, `program`, `cwd`, `gdb_path`, `timeout` | Attach GDB to an existing local process. |
| `gdb_load_core` | Mutation | `core` | `core_path`*, `session_id`, `program`, `cwd`, `gdb_path`, `timeout` | Load a core dump into a GDB session. |
| `gdb_connect_gdbserver` | Mutation | `advanced:remote_target` | `endpoint`*, `session_id`, `program`, `cwd`, `gdb_path`, `extended`, `sysroot`, `solib_search_path`, `timeout` | Connect a session to an existing gdbserver endpoint. |
| `gdb_launch_gdbserver` | Execution | `advanced:remote_target` | `program`*, `listen`, `target_endpoint`, `args`, `cwd`, `gdb_path`, `gdbserver_path`, `extended`, `sysroot`, `solib_search_path`, `timeout` | Launch a local gdbserver and connect a new GDB session to it. |
| `gdb_list_sessions` | Read | `core` | none | List active GDB sessions. |
| `gdb_status` | Read | `core` | `session_id`* | Return one session's status. |
| `gdb_close_session` | Execution | `core` | `session_id`* | Close a GDB session and any child gdbserver process. |
| `gdb_close_idle_sessions` | Mutation | `advanced:diagnostics` | `max_idle_seconds` | Close live sessions idle for at least max_idle_seconds. |

## Execution

| Tool | Safety | Profile | Parameters | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gdb_run` | Execution | `full` | `session_id`*, `args`, `timeout`, `auto_interrupt` | Run or restart the inferior and wait until it stops. |
| `gdb_run_and_context` | Execution | `core` | `session_id`*, `args`, `timeout`, `auto_interrupt`, `max_frames`, `include_raw`, `output` | Run or restart the inferior, then return a compact stop context. |
| `gdb_restart` | Execution | `full` | `session_id`*, `args`, `timeout`, `auto_interrupt` | Restart the inferior and wait until it stops. |
| `gdb_continue` | Execution | `full` | `session_id`*, `timeout`, `auto_interrupt` | Continue execution and wait until the target stops. |
| `gdb_continue_and_context` | Execution | `core` | `session_id`*, `timeout`, `auto_interrupt`, `max_frames`, `include_raw`, `output` | Continue execution, then return a compact stop or exit summary. |
| `gdb_interrupt` | Execution | `core` | `session_id`*, `timeout` | Interrupt a running target. |
| `gdb_signal` | Execution | `full` | `session_id`*, `signal_name`*, `timeout` | Resume the inferior with a signal such as SIGTERM or 0. |
| `gdb_step` | Execution | `full` | `session_id`*, `instruction`, `timeout` | Step into one source line or machine instruction. |
| `gdb_step_and_context` | Execution | `core` | `session_id`*, `instruction`, `timeout`, `max_frames`, `include_raw`, `output` | Step into one source line or instruction, then return compact context. |
| `gdb_next` | Execution | `full` | `session_id`*, `instruction`, `timeout` | Step over one source line or machine instruction. |
| `gdb_next_and_context` | Execution | `core` | `session_id`*, `instruction`, `timeout`, `max_frames`, `include_raw`, `output` | Step over one source line or instruction, then return compact context. |
| `gdb_detach` | Execution | `full` | `session_id`*, `timeout` | Detach GDB from the current target while keeping the session alive. |
| `gdb_kill` | Execution | `full` | `session_id`*, `timeout` | Kill the current inferior while keeping the GDB session alive. |
| `gdb_execute` | Unsafe | `advanced:unsafe` | `session_id`*, `command`*, `timeout`, `wait_for_stop`, `auto_interrupt` | Execute an unrestricted CLI or raw MI command when unsafe mode is enabled. |

## Reverse Debugging

| Tool | Safety | Profile | Parameters | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gdb_rr_record` | Execution | `advanced:reverse_debugging` | `program`*, `args`, `cwd`, `rr_path`, `trace_dir`, `disable_syscall_buffer`, `timeout` | Record one program run with rr and return the trace directory. |
| `gdb_start_rr_replay_session` | Mutation | `advanced:reverse_debugging` | `trace_dir`, `cwd`, `rr_path`, `startup_timeout` | Start a GDB/MI session backed by rr replay. |
| `gdb_start_recording` | Mutation | `advanced:reverse_debugging` | `session_id`*, `method`, `timeout` | Enable GDB process recording for reverse debugging. |
| `gdb_stop_recording` | Mutation | `advanced:reverse_debugging` | `session_id`*, `timeout` | Stop GDB process recording when a recording target is active. |
| `gdb_record_status` | Read | `advanced:reverse_debugging` | `session_id`* | Return GDB recording status. |
| `gdb_reverse_continue` | Execution | `advanced:reverse_debugging` | `session_id`*, `timeout`, `auto_interrupt` | Run backward until the target stops. |
| `gdb_reverse_continue_and_context` | Execution | `advanced:reverse_debugging` | `session_id`*, `timeout`, `auto_interrupt`, `max_frames`, `include_raw`, `output` | Run backward, then return a compact stop or exit summary. |
| `gdb_reverse_step` | Execution | `advanced:reverse_debugging` | `session_id`*, `instruction`, `timeout` | Step backward into one source line or machine instruction. |
| `gdb_reverse_step_and_context` | Execution | `advanced:reverse_debugging` | `session_id`*, `instruction`, `timeout`, `max_frames`, `include_raw`, `output` | Step backward into one line or instruction, then return compact context. |
| `gdb_reverse_next` | Execution | `advanced:reverse_debugging` | `session_id`*, `instruction`, `timeout` | Step backward over one source line or machine instruction. |
| `gdb_reverse_next_and_context` | Execution | `advanced:reverse_debugging` | `session_id`*, `instruction`, `timeout`, `max_frames`, `include_raw`, `output` | Step backward over one line or instruction, then return compact context. |
| `gdb_reverse_finish` | Execution | `advanced:reverse_debugging` | `session_id`*, `timeout` | Run backward to the call site of the selected frame. |
| `gdb_reverse_finish_and_context` | Execution | `advanced:reverse_debugging` | `session_id`*, `timeout`, `max_frames`, `include_raw`, `output` | Run backward to the caller, then return compact context. |

## Breakpoints and Watchpoints

| Tool | Safety | Profile | Parameters | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gdb_set_breakpoint` | Mutation | `core` | `session_id`*, `location`*, `condition`, `temporary`, `hardware` | Set a breakpoint using GDB CLI syntax. |
| `gdb_set_watchpoint` | Mutation | `full` | `session_id`*, `expression`*, `access` | Set a watchpoint for a read-safe expression. |
| `gdb_enable_breakpoint` | Mutation | `full` | `session_id`*, `number`* | Enable a breakpoint by number. |
| `gdb_disable_breakpoint` | Mutation | `full` | `session_id`*, `number`* | Disable a breakpoint by number. |
| `gdb_breakpoint_condition` | Mutation | `full` | `session_id`*, `number`*, `condition` | Set or clear a breakpoint condition. |
| `gdb_breakpoint_commands` | Unsafe | `advanced:unsafe` | `session_id`*, `number`*, `commands`* | Set breakpoint command-list actions. |
| `gdb_delete_breakpoint` | Execution | `core` | `session_id`*, `number`* | Delete a breakpoint by number. |
| `gdb_list_breakpoints` | Read | `core` | `session_id`* | List breakpoints as structured MI data. |

## Inspection, Registers, and Memory

| Tool | Safety | Profile | Parameters | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gdb_eval_expression` | Read | `core` | `session_id`*, `expression`*, `timeout` | Evaluate a read-safe expression in the selected frame. |
| `gdb_print` | Read | `full` | `session_id`*, `expression`*, `timeout` | Print a read-safe expression using GDB's normal formatting. |
| `gdb_call_function` | Unsafe | `advanced:unsafe` | `session_id`*, `expression`*, `timeout` | Call an inferior function or evaluate an unsafe expression. |
| `gdb_set_variable` | Unsafe | `advanced:unsafe` | `session_id`*, `expression`*, `value`*, `timeout` | Set an inferior variable or lvalue expression. |
| `gdb_disassemble` | Read | `full` | `session_id`*, `location`, `start_address`, `end_address`, `mixed`, `raw_bytes` | Disassemble a function/location or an address range. |
| `gdb_disassemble_current_frame` | Read | `full` | `session_id`*, `mixed`, `raw_bytes` | Disassemble the selected frame's current function. |
| `gdb_disassemble_around_pc` | Read | `core` | `session_id`*, `bytes_before`, `bytes_after`, `mixed`, `raw_bytes` | Disassemble a byte window around the current program counter. |
| `gdb_current_location` | Read | `core` | `session_id`* | Return the selected frame and last known stop location. |
| `gdb_context` | Read | `core` | `session_id`*, `max_frames`, `include_raw`, `output` | Return a compact current location, backtrace, and locals summary. |
| `gdb_find_source` | Read | `full` | `session_id`*, `query`*, `limit` | List known source files whose paths contain query. |
| `gdb_source` | Read | `core` | `session_id`*, `location` | List source around the current frame or a source location. |
| `gdb_registers` | Read | `core` | `session_id`*, `register_numbers`, `fmt` | Read register values. |
| `gdb_register_names` | Read | `full` | `session_id`*, `register_numbers` | List register names, optionally limited to GDB register numbers. |
| `gdb_read_register` | Read | `core` | `session_id`*, `register`*, `timeout` | Read one register by architecture name, such as rax, pc, sp, or $rip. |
| `gdb_read_memory` | Read | `core` | `session_id`*, `address`*, `count`*, `output`, `cursor`, `page_size` | Read raw memory bytes. |
| `gdb_write_memory` | Unsafe | `advanced:unsafe` | `session_id`*, `address`*, `data_hex`* | Write raw bytes to memory. |
| `gdb_search_memory` | Read | `full` | `session_id`*, `start_address`*, `length`*, `pattern`*, `output` | Search memory for a GDB find pattern. |
| `gdb_read_c_string` | Read | `full` | `session_id`*, `address`*, `max_bytes`, `output` | Read a NUL-terminated C string from memory. |
| `gdb_shared_libraries` | Read | `full` | `session_id`* | List shared libraries known to GDB. |
| `gdb_info_files` | Read | `full` | `session_id`* | Return GDB's info files output. |
| `gdb_memory_mappings` | Read | `full` | `session_id`*, `output`, `cursor`, `page_size` | Return process memory mappings when supported by the target. |

## Binary Analysis

| Tool | Safety | Profile | Parameters | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gdb_pwn_context` | Read | `advanced:binary_analysis` | `session_id`*, `max_frames`, `telescope_count`, `nearpc_lines`, `output` | Return a pwndbg-style structured context for stripped/optimized binaries. |
| `gdb_binary_summary` | Read | `advanced:binary_analysis` | `session_id`, `file_path`, `timeout`, `output` | Return a pwn-oriented binary summary: ELF metadata, checksec, base, and maps. |
| `gdb_register_context` | Read | `advanced:binary_analysis` | `session_id`* | Return pwndbg-style grouped registers for quick pwn context inspection. |
| `gdb_vmmap_structured` | Read | `advanced:binary_analysis` | `session_id`*, `address`, `module`, `executable`, `writable`, `include_gaps`, `output`, `cursor`, `page_size` | Return structured virtual memory mappings with address/module/perms filters. |
| `gdb_address_info` | Read | `advanced:binary_analysis` | `session_id`*, `expression`*, `read_string`, `string_max_bytes` | Resolve an address expression to mapping, module offset, symbol, and string context. |
| `gdb_rva_info` | Read | `advanced:binary_analysis` | `session_id`*, `offset`*, `module`, `read_string` | Resolve a module RVA to a runtime address and annotate it like pwndbg xinfo. |
| `gdb_telescope` | Read | `advanced:binary_analysis` | `session_id`*, `address`, `count`, `pointer_size`, `max_depth`, `reverse`, `output` | Read pointer-sized stack/memory slots and annotate recursively dereferenced values. |
| `gdb_nearpc` | Read | `advanced:binary_analysis` | `session_id`*, `pc`, `lines`, `reverse`, `instruction_bytes` | Disassemble near an address and return parsed instruction rows. |
| `gdb_symbols` | Read | `advanced:binary_analysis` | `session_id`*, `query`, `kind`, `limit`, `output`, `cursor`, `page_size` | Search GDB-known functions or variables and return parsed symbol rows. |
| `gdb_got` | Read | `advanced:binary_analysis` | `session_id`, `file_path`, `query`, `module`, `limit`, `timeout`, `output`, `cursor`, `page_size` | List dynamic relocation/GOT entries, optionally annotated with runtime VAs. |
| `gdb_piebase` | Read | `advanced:binary_analysis` | `session_id`*, `offset`, `module` | Calculate a runtime virtual address from a PIE/module base plus offset. |
| `gdb_break_rva` | Mutation | `advanced:binary_analysis` | `session_id`*, `offset`*, `module`, `temporary`, `hardware` | Set a breakpoint at module PIE base plus an RVA-style offset. |
| `gdb_checksec` | Read | `advanced:binary_analysis` | `session_id`, `file_path`, `timeout`, `output` | Return ELF hardening settings such as PIE, NX, RELRO, and stack canary. |
| `gdb_elf_info` | Read | `advanced:binary_analysis` | `session_id`, `file_path`, `include_raw`, `timeout`, `output` | Return ELF header, security, section, segment, and build-id metadata. |

| Tool | Safety | Profile | Parameters | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gdb_capabilities` | Read | `core` | none | Return a workflow-oriented capability index for agent tool selection. |
| `gdb_server_health` | Read | `core` | none | Report server capabilities, safety mode, dependencies, and session count. |
